installs.validated: renders a valid diagram to a 22 KB SVG; a malformed diagram exits 1 and writes NO file (the must-fail gate)

installs.method: GitHub release zip -> infra/tools/structurizr (pinned, not on PATH)
installs.requires: Java 17+ (17.0.12 LTS already present; Temurin install not needed)
installs.validated: validate exits 0 on a well-formed workspace; export -format mermaid writes one .mmd per view

gotchas: Structurizr rejects a UTF-8 BOM: 'Unexpected tokens (expected: workspace) at line 1'. The DSL writer must emit UTF-8 WITHOUT BOM (PowerShell's -Encoding utf8 adds one; Python's default open(..., encoding='utf-8') does not).
Structurizr view blocks must be multi-line; `systemContext sys { include * }` on one line is a parse error.
The Structurizr CLI cannot rasterize: it validates and exports (mermaid/plantuml/dot/json). Rendering to SVG goes through mmdc.
